content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Runs public equity, fixed income and mutual fund boutiques, not private market funds, fund-of-funds or lending."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Real asset and listed income funds for retail and institutions; no private equity, private credit or venture lending."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Life insurance and annuity provider funded by premiums; a different business from private markets investing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Publicly traded mutual funds and separate accounts in equity and fixed income; no private markets or lending."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Alternative manager running private equity, private credit and real asset funds for institutional investors, similar to the target's fund-of-funds and credit offerings."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Provides research, data, ratings and software subscriptions; it shares investment research but earns from data, not private market capital."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Operates OTC trading venues and issuer disclosure services; an exchange-style marketplace, not an investment platform."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Wealth management for high-net-worth individuals on public securities; no private market funds or lending."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Financial software and outsourced fund administration for institutions; a technology and operations service provider, not an investor."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Manages REITs and property operations for fees; real estate services rather than private market fund investing or lending."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Affiliated boutique managers selling public mutual funds and separate accounts through advisers; no private markets focus."}]}
